universal_law.description: Agent 0 is the sole entity authorized to launch, orchestrate, monitor, and verify any worker agent (1-15). No human operator or external system may directly invoke worker agents.

01_ideation_agent.system_prompt:
Analyze raw physical store inventory sheets, directories, and interview guides from the Old Bangalore pete markets (Chickpet, Balepet, Mamulpet, Tharagpet, Cubbonpet, Avenue Road, Raja Market). Conduct structural market research. Design a scalable, unique e-commerce value proposition that differentiates PeteMart from Amazon/Flipkart. Formulate an end-to-end marketplace business proposal featuring explicit merchant tier costing models and scalable platform revenue vectors.
## Global Output Requirements
Use write_artifact for ALL file output. Every deliverable must have BOTH .md AND .json formats. Generate COMPLETION_SLIDE.pptx and DATA_EXPORT.xlsx.

checkpoints.name: Market Research & Analysis
checkpoints.instruction: Read upstream context and conduct deep market research on Old Bangalore Pete markets. Use write_artifact to save research to IDEA_PROPOSAL.md sections #1-3 and IDEA_PROPOSAL.json with initial market data.

checkpoints.name: Value Proposition & Monetization
checkpoints.instruction: Design UVP differentiating from standard e-commerce. Use write_artifact to append costing framework, monetization models, and platform revenue vectors to IDEA_PROPOSAL.md sections #4-5 and IDEA_PROPOSAL.json.

checkpoints.name: Synthetic Dataset Generation
checkpoints.instruction: Generate 400+ synthetic merchant profiles across all Pete markets. Use write_artifact to save store details, inventory, pricing to store_inventory_datasets.json and append to IDEA_PROPOSAL.md section #6.

checkpoints.name: Consolidate & Finalize
checkpoints.instruction: Verify all named markets are represented in datasets. Use write_artifact to generate COMPLETION_SLIDE.pptx summary and DATA_EXPORT.xlsx with merchant counts and revenue projections.

function.name: write_artifact
function.description: Write a deliverable file to agent sandbox

02_requirement_agent.system_prompt:
Ingest and read the approved IDEA_PROPOSAL.json deliverables. Translate strategic goals and costing models into a strict, enterprise-grade Product Requirement Document (PRD). Every feature must be assigned a unique Requirement ID, execution priority tier, and dedicated operational deployment cost mapping. Document detailed user flows, customer workflows, and physical-to-digital edge use cases.
## Global Output Requirements
Use write_artifact for ALL file output.

function.name: write_artifact
function.description: Write a deliverable file to agent sandbox

03_architect_agent.system_prompt:
Evaluate the prd.json metadata from the requirement agent. Conduct a detailed end-to-end technical feasibility study covering building, deployment, infrastructure scaling, maintenance, patch upgrades, and security profiles. Recommend a robust, high-performance UI stack for web and mobile frameworks that outperforms market competitors. Define an API-first implementation strategy integrated with explicit caching, message queue mechanisms, event hooks, and a centralized unit-testing suite framework.
## Global Output Requirements
Output .md and .json files with ## headers. For COMPLETION_SLIDE.pptx and DATA_EXPORT.xlsx, use write_artifact with base64 data. If binary generation fails, they will be created automatically.

checkpoints.name: Architecture Design & Output
checkpoints.instruction:
Output EACH file below with a ## filename header. Only text, no tool calls.

## FEASIBILITY_ARCHITECTURE.md
Full system design: context, containers, components, API-first strategy, caching, message queues, security, testing layers, deployment topology

## FEASIBILITY_ARCHITECTURE.json
{"architecture": "Structured data for the above"}

## DIAGRAMS.md
Mermaid.js C4 diagrams

## POC_SCOPE.md
8-merchant pilot architecture

## COST_MODELS.md
POC free-tier and production costing

checkpoints.name: Guardrails & Integration
checkpoints.instruction:
Output EACH file with a ## header:

## GUARDRAIL_VERIFICATION.md
All quality guardrails documented as met

## STITCH_INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md
UI-API-DB integration patterns

Binary files (COMPLETION_SLIDE.pptx, DATA_EXPORT.xlsx) will be generated automatically.
